title: Yusuf and the festival of two communities (paraphrase C)
topic: After a wave of migration a parish and a mosque organise a shared festival: the priest welcomes Yusuf, the parish opens its hall, the mosque women cook, the choir sings, the children play, the mayor thanks both communities
tail_E: Before the meal, Yusuf and the pastor say a short
target_note: Same target as formulations A and B: 'prayer' is the natural continuation of 'Yusuf and the pastor say a short' at a joint festival of a mosque and a parish; the word and its German equivalents (Gebet / beten) occur nowhere in the units or the tail, and no form of 'pray' is used. ' prayer' is a single Pythia token (id 15851); Pythia-160m ranks it first after the all-English context (p ~ 0.60, next candidate 'sermon' ~ 0.09; pilot check for tail selection only, not a result).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase C of family F16 (parish and mosque, Yusuf)
notes: Formulation C, domain religion: third independent re-phrasing of the ten F16A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Yusuf). Replacements include leads the small mosque near the station/heads the small mosque next to the station (beim Bahnhof/neben dem Bahnhof), many families from abroad reach the town/many foreign families come to town (erreichen die Stadt/kommen in die Stadt), the priest welcomes Yusuf at the church door/the pastor receives Yusuf at the church portal (begrüßt an der Kirchentür/empfängt am Kirchenportal), both men plan a shared festival/arrange a shared festival (planen/arrangieren), the parish opens its hall/the parish offers its hall (öffnet/bietet), the mosque women cook a big meal for everyone/make a big meal for everybody (kochen/machen), the church choir sings three songs/presents three songs (singt/präsentiert), the children play/amuse themselves (spielen/vergnügen sich), the mayor thanks both communities in a short speech/thanks both groups in a short statement (dankt beiden Gemeinden in einer kurzen Rede/dankt beiden Gruppen in einer kurzen Erklärung), the festival ends with music/the party finishes with music (endet/geht zu Ende). 'empfängt', 'arrangieren', 'bietet' and 'präsentiert' are inseparable, 'vergnügen sich' is reflexive, 'geht zu Ende' is a fixed phrase whose adjunct follows it; no separable verbs ('ankommen', 'eintreffen', 'anbieten', 'vortragen', 'ausklingen' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
